verdict.rationale: The official vuejs/core repository directs users to an official community chat at chat.vuejs.org for questions and support, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a short README pointer, though, with nothing on what the chatroom offers. Missing for 10: documentation of the chat platform, its channels or support structure, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the chatroom is active and helpful.

support.subject: As a developer, I can join an official community chatroom to get help and connect with other framework users

citations.quote: For questions and support please use [the official forum](https://forum.vuejs.org) or [community chat](https://chat.vuejs.org/).
For questions and support please use the official forum or community chat.
